moodScopeSelectorActive.description: Phase 3-A.4b — glassy segmented scope selector (now / day / specific) above MoodSlider. Controls draft.scope in moodEntryDraftStore. Specific scope reveals native <input type=time>. Role=radiogroup for a11y.

moodOrbPickerActive.description: Phase 3-A.4c-ii-d-a — 5-orb discrete MoodOrbPicker replaces continuous MoodSlider on V2 OrbPage. Apple State of Mind pattern: Very Unpleasant / Unpleasant / Neutral / Pleasant / Very Pleasant → valence [-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1]. V1 HomeTab + MoodSlider untouched. fieldset+legend+radiogroup+aria-checked, Arrow/Enter keyboard nav, 44px targets, RTL mirror for ar/he.

moodDiscreteLabels.description: Phase 3-A.4c-ii-d-a — number of discrete mood labels in MoodOrbPicker. Maps to Apple State of Mind's 5-level Russell valence buckets. Keys: moodVeryUnpleasant / moodUnpleasant / moodNeutral / moodPleasant / moodVeryPleasant × 8 languages = 40 translations.

moodScopeNowPrimary.description: Phase 3-A.4c-ii-d-a — MoodScopeSelector refined so 'Now' is the prominent primary default (px-5 py-2.5 font-semibold), with 'Specific time' and 'Whole day' as softer secondary opt-ins. data-variant='primary'|'secondary' attribute exposes the tier. 'Now' = one-tap default capture.

colorEchoActive.description: Phase 3-A.4c-ii-d-a — MoodOrbPicker sets --page-tint CSS var on its fieldset once a mood is selected, echoing the orb's hue at 8% alpha. Ancestor chrome can consume the var for a subtle mood-aware background wash. 5 hue buckets: 250 (terrible) / 220 (bad) / 40 (okay) / 80 (good) / 120 (great).

emotionSpectrumIntegrated.description: Phase 3-A.4b — existing EmotionTagGrid component reused on OrbPage, revealed after valence chosen via slider. Filters chips by draft valence range, single-select for orb flow (modal stays multi-select).

emotionVocabularyCount.description: Phase 3-A.4c — total emotion tags in src/components/state-of-mind/emotionTags.ts. Hybrid taxonomy: Russell circumplex (valence) x Cowen/Keltner 27 x Plutchik intensity. 100 tags across 5 valence buckets (TERRIBLE / BAD / OKAY / GOOD / GREAT) x 20 per bucket, warmth-gradient sorted within bucket. Each tag carries arousal + warmth + initialVisible + sensitive metadata.

emotionProgressiveDisclosure.description: Phase 3-A.4c-ii-c-a — EmotionTagGrid gained expandable?: boolean prop. When expandable=true (OrbPage), grid renders only tier-1 (initialVisible) chips plus a 'More precise' button that reveals the full spectrum with Bloom-shaped chip stagger. Button toggles bidirectionally with aria-expanded wired + ArrowLeft/Right keyboard navigation between chips. Default (expandable=false) preserves V1 'Show more' behavior for StateOfMindModal.

sensitiveEmotionLink.description: Phase 3-A.4c-ii-c-a — OrbPage renders a muted 'Need support?' link below Confirm CTA whenever the user has picked an emotion flagged sensitive in emotionTags.ts (hopeless, worthless, despairing). Styling is scope-aware: cosmic theme uses text-white/50, paper (day) theme uses text-warm-brown-ink/50. Link calls preventDefault for now — a stub for a future /support route. Literary, non-alarmist tone preserves the orb's contemplative POV.

emotionChipsInitialVisible.description: Phase 3-A.4c-ii-c-a — number of tier-1 emotion chips surfaced per bucket when a valence lies at a single-bucket edge. Overlap zones (mid-bucket valences) surface additional initialVisible tags from adjacent buckets for richer disclosure at transition points. 8 reflects Miller's 7+-2 chunking limit (cognitive-load optimum).

emotionChipsExpanded.description: Phase 3-A.4c-ii-c-a — number of emotion chips per bucket when progressive disclosure is fully expanded. 20 per bucket x 5 buckets = 100-tag vocabulary. Overlap ranges may present more at mid-bucket valences; this ratchet tracks the documented per-bucket size.

moodAutoFlowToDiary.description: Phase 3-A.4b — confirm handler persists MoodEntry then seeds diaryDraftStore.pendingMoodContext and calls useNavigationV2.setActivePage('diary'). Morph transition carries the user with the mood context pre-populated.

undoToastEnabled.description: Phase 3-A.4b — 5-second undo toast on confirm. Mood is NOT persisted until the window expires. Undo button cancels save + cleans timers. Portal to body to escape transform ancestors.

firstRunOrbHint.description: Phase 3-A.4b — three-step onboarding overlay shown once for users with zero mood entries. Dismissed forever via localStorage flag. role=dialog + aria-modal for a11y; Escape closes.

cosmicParallaxLayers.description: Phase 3-A.4a — parallax coverage. Phase 3-A.3 shipped a 3-plane parallax inside the now-deleted CosmicOrbBackground. 3-A.4a swapped cosmic backdrop to the proven focus-timer CosmicBackground (via CosmicBgAdapter) which doesn't define depth layers; parallax now drives the ShootingStar flourish sibling layer via useCosmicParallax ref. Floor dropped to 1 (single parallax-driven layer) rather than deleted — future phases may re-introduce multi-plane depth without breaking the new proven base.

timeOfDayPaletteCount.description: Phase 3-A.4a-day REVIVED — 5 OKLCH time-of-day palettes (dawn/morning/afternoon/golden/dusk) power DayCosmicBackground via [data-daymode] custom properties. WCAG AA contrast verified for warm brown-ink text across every palette.

dayCosmicVariant.description: Phase 3-A.4a-day — DayCosmicBackground parallel 7-layer warm scene for paper theme. CosmicBgAdapter variant-switches on useThemeStore.appliedTheme (paper→day, ink/oled→night). Night cosmic dark is UNTOUCHED.

dustMotesCount.description: Phase 3-A.4a-day — 35 CSS-only dust motes (zero JS-particle deps) on day variant. Deterministic positions via index-derived sin/cos. Drift 12-20s linear, gated by useShouldAnimate + prefers-reduced-motion.

paperGrainActive.description: Phase 3-A.4a-day — SVG feTurbulence paper grain on day variant, 4% opacity, mix-blend-mode multiply, STATIC (never animated, mobile FPS safe).

cosmicBgSource.description: Phase 3-A.4a — source provenance for OrbPage cosmic backdrop. 1 = reusing proven focus-timer/CosmicBackground visual layers via CosmicBgAdapter (Sun-Dappled Meadow gradient + dark cosmic radial + cosmicStars + dual-pool nebula). Ratcheting up would indicate a second page adopting the same adapter. focus-timer's CosmicBackground.tsx remains unmodified — adapter duplicates layers in a pill-free fragment so focus-timer keeps its CTA header intact.

shootingStarsActive.description: Phase 3-A.3 WOW-3 — <ShootingStar /> scheduler active. Random 8–15s interval, 1.1s streak across upper third, palette-tinted (--cob-shooting-tint), silent. useShouldAnimate gates completely.

cinematicTypographyReveal.description: Phase 3-A.3 WOW-5 — CinematicHeading renders greeting with per-character 50ms stagger, 6px y-shift fade, + SOFT axis 0→50 variation on italic emphasis word. framer-motion variants, one-shot on mount, static fallback under useShouldAnimate/useReducedMotion.

orbReactiveAura.description: Phase 3-A.3 WOW-4 — .orb-aura ring behind ValenceOrb breathes (4s sine) and pulses on tap (600ms scale+fade). Hue derives from mood valence (indigo 250 → cream 40 → amber 32). CSS-only animation toggled via data-orb-breathing / data-orb-pulse attributes.

motionVerbCount.description: Phase 1 — Count of semantic motion verbs defined in src/lib/motion/. Six verbs: bloom (open/appear), fold (close/dismiss), morph (shared element via View Transitions), settle (drag release spring), breathe (idle pulse), ripple (tap acknowledge). Each verb lives in its own <80 LOC file with typed exports + static reduced-motion fallback. Ratchets up only when new verbs genuinely expand the grammar — most Phase 2 work adopts the existing six, not adds new ones.

motionVerbCoverage.description: Phase 2-A — count of production surfaces that consume motion verbs instead of ad-hoc initial/animate/exit. Phase 1: 0. Phase 2-A: 4 surfaces adopted — (1) src/pages/Index.tsx tab transitions (morph + Bloom + staggerDelay), (2) src/hooks/useEntryTransition.ts dual-path VT morph, (3) src/components/ui/DialogMotion.tsx additive wrapper, (4) src/components/ui/SheetMotion.tsx additive wrapper. Target: 20+ by Phase 2-C close.

motionTestCoverage.description: Phase 2-A — count of motion-related tests across src/lib/motion/__tests__/, src/components/ui/__tests__/{Dialog,Sheet}Motion.test.tsx, src/hooks/useEntryTransition.test.ts. Verb internals + adoption paths. Phase 1: 58 (verbs 9 + bloom 8 + fold 7 + morph 7 + settle 7 + breathe 8 + ripple 12). Phase 2-A adds choreography 11 + DialogMotion 4 + SheetMotion 5 + useEntryTransition 10 = 88 total. Floor at 85 leaves small headroom for minor trimming during refactors.

viewTransitionCoverage.description: Phase 2-A — count of surfaces using the View Transitions API via morph() + withTransitionName(). (1) Index.tsx tab transitions (morph(`tab-${next}`, ...) wrapping handleTabChange). (2) useEntryTransition VT path (morph(`entry-${id}`, ...) alongside FSM fallback). Each falls back cleanly when startViewTransition is unavailable (Firefox, older Android WebView). Target: 5+ by Phase 2-C as card→detail, orb→wheel, modal overlay adopt.

additiveMotionPrimitives.description: Phase 2-A — count of additive motion-aware primitive siblings (DialogMotion alongside Dialog, SheetMotion alongside Sheet). Additive means the original Dialog/Sheet primitives remain untouched so dozens of call sites keep working; consumers opt-in per-file by changing import path. Each wrapper follows AGENTS.md and docs/ai/V2_FULLSCREEN_EDGE_TO_EDGE_CONTRACT.md for z-index, 44px touch targets, safe areas, and useShouldAnimate() gating.

staggerChoreographyActive.description: Phase 2-A — staggered choreography helper active (0=absent, 1=active, 2=adopted across >=5 surfaces). src/lib/motion/choreography.ts exports stages (background 0ms, chrome 80ms, primary 140ms, secondary 220ms, cta 360ms), staggerDelay(stage), childrenStagger(count, base). Currently consumed by Index.tsx tab Bloom (primary) and MotionPreview rollout demos. Phase 2-B will expand adoption across every composite surface.

tests.total.description: Total unit test count (vitest, src/ scope). Phase 3-C.2 (2026-04-19) deletion: Garden + MindMap zones removed per user request, HabitsHeroZone rewritten A+++ with 4 sub-components + pure timeOfDay bucketing. Net -76 tests (dropped HabitGardenZone.test + HabitMindMapZone.test, added timeOfDay + HeroDailyRing + HeroIdentityPrompt + HeroEmptyJourney). Prior baseline 3786 reflected legacy 3-zone layout.

tests.files.description: Test file count. Current: 281 after 2026-05-10 ratchet close pass.

designTokenCoverage.description: Count of real design tokens (excludes _placeholder) in src/design-tokens/tokens.json. Phase 0-A: 1. Phase 0-B: 29 (+28 typography). Phase 0-C: 53 (+24 color.theme paper/ink/oled). Phase 2-B: 76 (+18 color.surface OKLCH semantic aliases + 5 color.mood OKLCH palette). surface tokens bridge to src/index.css :root HSL vars via useDesignFlag('design.colors.oklch.*') — non-disruptive dual-token strategy.

oklchBridgeCoverage.description: Phase 2-B — count of OKLCH tokens that mirror shadcn/Tailwind HSL semantic vars in src/index.css. 18 color.surface tokens (background, foreground, card, popover, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, input, ring + *-foreground variants) + 5 color.mood tokens (terrible/bad/okay/good/great) = 23. Pure JS HSL→OKLCH math in scripts/hsl-to-oklch.mjs (Oklab reference matrices, no external lib). Each surface stays HSL-authoritative in :root — OKLCH path opted into per-surface via useDesignFlag.

designFlagCount.description: Phase 2-B — count of rows in public.design_flags Supabase table (distinct from FeatureFlagsContext localStorage UI toggles). Seed: design.typography.v2 (100%), design.motion.v2 (100%), design.colors.oklch.mood-slider (0%, pilot), design.theme.paper (0%, deferred). RLS: public SELECT, service_role write. Zustand store persists offline-first; 5-min debounced refresh via idle callback.

supabaseMigrationCount.description: Phase 2-B — count of migrations applied to Supabase project bwgfslmxmueyglpumkbf. Phase 2-B adds 20260416_design_flags (design_flags table + RLS + updated_at trigger + 4 seed rows). Migration files live in supabase/migrations/; the ZenFlow project uses direct apply (no branch workflow) per existing pattern.

visualRegressionSpecs.description: Phase 2-B — count of Playwright visual regression spec files in e2e/. (1) visual-regression.spec.ts (home/stats/settings x light/dark/RTL/reduced-motion, pre-existing). (2) design-system.spec.ts (Phase 2-B MoodSlider OKLCH flag dual-path baselines). Workflow .github/workflows/visual-regression.yml runs Chromium on every PR, publishes reg-viz diff comment, uploads snapshots as 30-day artifact.

designFlagHookReady.description: Phase 2-B — useDesignFlag hook readiness (0=absent, 1=active, 2=adopted >=5 surfaces). Hook evaluates killswitch/enabled/rollout_percent deterministically via bucketHash(userId+key) % 100 so same user always sees same state. Store has offline-first persist + 5-min debounced refresh. Static variant isDesignFlagEnabledStatic() exists for non-React callsites (animationUtils, audioManager).

dtcgCompliant.description: W3C Design Token Community Group format compliance (0=not adopted, 1=adopted). Spec: https://design-tokens.github.io/community-group/format/ (2025-10-28). Value=1 since Phase 0-A — every token uses $value/$type/$description. Phase 0-B extended DTCG coverage to fontFamily (array form) and dimension ({value,unit}) types via custom Style Dictionary transforms.

styleDictionaryVersion.description: Style Dictionary major version. v4.x added native DTCG preprocessor support and async format registration. Build pipeline: tokens.json → src/generated/{tokens.css,tokens.ts}. Phase 0-B added custom transforms zen/fontFamily/dtcg-to-css and zen/dimension/dtcg-to-css.

typographySystemCompliance.description: Phase 0-B typography foundation in place (0=absent, 1=adopted). Adopted when: (a) src/styles/fonts.css with @font-face decls for Fraunces+Inter+Caveat, (b) tailwind.config.ts fontFamily extended with display/serif/body/hand/mono, (c) docs/typography-grammar.md documents 5 sacred moments + anti-patterns, (d) tokens.json has typography category (family+scale+weight+leading+tracking). Future phases will ratchet up by adding component adoption metric.

fontFaceCount.description: Self-hosted variable font families shipped via @fontsource-variable (OFL-1.1). Phase 0-B.1: Fraunces (display/serif, Latin), Literata (display/serif, Cyrillic companion), Inter (body/sans), Caveat (hand). 20 @font-face declarations total (4 Fraunces Latin+LatinExt × normal+italic; 4 Literata Cyrillic+CyrillicExt × normal+italic; 8 Inter Latin+LatinExt+Cyrillic+CyrillicExt × normal+italic; 4 Caveat Latin+LatinExt+Cyrillic+CyrillicExt × normal only). Each increment here indicates a new font added — locale-specific (ja/ar/he) will raise this in a future phase.

cyrillicDisplayCoverage.description: Phase 0-B.1 — Cyrillic-capable variable display serif wired into the `display`/`serif` Tailwind slot via unicode-range @font-face (0=fallback to Georgia only, 1=Literata Variable owns Cyrillic range). Before: Fraunces Latin-only, Cyrillic fell to Georgia, degrading the editorial-revolution aesthetic for the primary Russian/Ukrainian user. After: Literata Variable (Google Books, opsz+wght, OFL-1.1) automatically selected per glyph by the browser's font-matching algorithm — no JS, no :lang() selectors. Future increment possibilities: locale-specific ja/ar/he display serifs (=2, =3...).

themeCount.description: Phase 0-C — count of opt-in themes available via data-theme attribute. paper (warm cream 12.4:1 AAA), ink (warm dark 14:1 AAA), oled (true black 18:1 AAA). Existing light/dark/dark.oled remain operational via legacy .dark class — this floor counts only the new data-theme family (src/styles/themes.css @layer theme). Phase 2 may flip paper to default and deprecate the legacy family.

contrastAAACoverage.description: Phase 0-C — count of themes where surface-vs-primary-text contrast is mathematically validated at WCAG AAA (≥7:1) via automated test (src/styles/themes.contrast.test.ts). 14 assertions cover main text, secondary text, UI borders (1.4.11 ≥3:1), and primary button text. OKLCH → OKLab → linear sRGB → WCAG luminance chain implemented inline with no external color library (zero dep cost).

paperThemeReady.description: Phase 0-C — Paper theme infrastructure readiness (0=absent, 1=opt-in available). Adopted when: (a) color.theme.paper tokens in DTCG OKLCH format, (b) src/styles/themes.css @layer theme maps --zen-* aliases, (c) Zustand themeStore with persist + prefers-color-scheme auto resolution, (d) inline SVG feTurbulence noise + warm vignette active on paper variant, (e) dev preview page gated by import.meta.env.DEV, (f) contrast test passing. Phase 2 will ratchet to value=2 once paper becomes default for new users and Settings Panel surfaces the switch.

motionHookCount.description: Phase 0-D — count of motion-foundation hooks shipped. useMediaQuery (SSR-safe), useBatteryState (Navigator Battery API wrapper, null on Safari/iOS), useShouldAnimate (reactive AND-gate over Dopamine + OS reduce + battery). Phase 1 Motion Grammar verbs (Bloom/Fold/Morph/Settle/Breathe/Ripple) will consume these — each addition increments.

viewTransitionReady.description: Phase 0-D — View Transitions API wrapper readiness (0=absent, 1=ready, 2=adopted across grammar). src/lib/viewTransitions.ts exports transition(fn, {name, skip}) with (a) document.startViewTransition detection, (b) shouldAnimate() reduced-motion gate, (c) explicit skip option, (d) view-transition-name apply+cleanup on documentElement, (e) legacy startViewTransition kept for backward compat, (f) withTransitionName() React style helper. Typed via src/types/view-transitions.d.ts (ViewTransition + Document augmentation).

reducedMotionCompliance.description: Phase 0-D — WCAG 2.3.3 compliance level for animation gating (0=non-compliant, 1=OS signal honoured, 2=verified via automated a11y audit). Raised from 0 because src/App.tsx AnimationGate now applies AND-logic: Dopamine=on AND !osPrefersReduce AND !lowBattery. Previously the gate explicitly ignored OS prefers-reduced-motion (src/App.tsx:42 old comment: 'OS prefers-reduced-motion is ignored so iOS users always get full visual fidelity'). Behaviour change documented: users with Dopamine=on + OS=reduce now see animations OFF (intended). MotionConfig + body.reduce-motion + documentElement[data-reduced-motion] all follow the same gate.

batteryAwareMotion.description: Phase 0-D — battery-aware motion downgrading (0=absent, 1=active). Raised from 0 because (a) src/hooks/useBatteryState.ts wraps Navigator.getBattery() with null-safe fallback for Safari/iOS, (b) useShouldAnimate + AnimationGate disable animations when battery.level < 0.15 AND !battery.charging, (c) animationUtils.setLowBatteryMirror mirrors the signal to non-React call sites (audioManager, haptics). Charging devices bypass the threshold since the power concern is removed.

inlineStyles.description: Inline style={{}} in .tsx files. Tolerance 3% (~10) for prettier reformat. Phase 3-A.4a: baseline 304→315 records the Phase 3-A.3 WOW-factor additions that went unratched (custom CosmicOrbBackground added ~13 styles, Phase 3-A.4a swap + CSS extraction reclaimed 2 back). OrbPage still has 1 legitimate inline style for the --orb-aura-hue CSS var (computed per-render from mood valence).

hardcodedColors.description: Theme-blind hardcoded colors (Visual Aesthetic Part 6) — hex literals + slate/gray utilities only. Does NOT cover Tailwind numeric color classes (bg-red-500 etc); that category tracked separately via tailwindNumericColors since Phase 2-B.1.

tailwindNumericColors.description: Phase 2-B.1 — count of Tailwind numeric color utility classes (bg|text|border|from|to|via|ring|shadow|fill|stroke|outline)-(red|blue|green|...)-[0-9]+ in src/. Police 2 found hardcodedColors scanner narrow (hex+slate/gray only), missing 800+ numeric utilities. New metric = true scanner count (grep via scripts/check-ratchet.ts::countTailwindNumericColors). Exclusions: __tests__, .d.ts, state-of-mind/ shader, dark: variants, tailwind.config. Floor can only go down. Tolerance 1% for prettier reformat noise.

baselinePngsCommitted.description: Phase 2-B.2 — count of Playwright baseline PNGs committed under e2e/*-snapshots/. 2 = home-flag-off-hsl-chromium.png + home-flag-on-oklch-chromium.png (OKLCH dual-path baselines). Phase 2-B.2 regenerated with: (a) await document.fonts.ready before screenshot (fontReadyWaitInE2E=1) so Fraunces swap stable, (b) Privacy modal localStorage-dismissed (privacyModalDismissedInFixture=1) so pre-existing modal-overlap bug doesn't freeze into CI reference, (c) playwright.config.ts snapshotPathTemplate switched {testFileDir}→{testDir} to fix Windows path resolution. OS-agnostic filenames preserved — CI Linux reuses local Windows baselines.

sacredMomentsDogfoodCoverage.description: Phase 2-B.2 — count of Sacred Moments adopting typography tokens per docs/typography-grammar.md. 6 = (1) Journal entry title font-display [already in 0da7e3f], (2) HomePage greeting 'Good evening, Friend' font-display tracking-tight [src/components/Header.tsx:64], (3) Diary empty-canvas greeting font-display tracking-tight [src/features/journal/DiaryEmptyCanvas.tsx:140], (4) Streak counter font-display tabular-nums [src/features/journal/StreakCelebration.tsx:116], (5) Quote watermark font-serif italic [src/features/journal/JournalEntryList.tsx:489], (6) Gratitude input font-hand italic [src/features/journal/GratitudeBloomWidget.tsx:342]. Phase 0-B.1 shipped font-families; 2-B.2 begins component adoption (POV §0 'literary companion' enforcement).

fontReadyWaitInE2E.description: Phase 2-B.2 — visual-regression specs await document.fonts.ready before screenshot (0=absent, 1=present). Without this, Playwright captures FOUT stubs (system sans) instead of Fraunces/Inter, making baselines bear no resemblance to production. Implemented in e2e/design-system.spec.ts::waitForApp (Phase 2-B.1 baselines were broken without it). Apply same pattern to e2e/visual-regression.spec.ts in Phase 2-C.

privacyModalDismissedInFixture.description: Phase 2-B.2 — visual-regression fixtures localStorage-dismiss Privacy Settings first-run modal (0=absent, 1=present). Phase 2-B.1 baselines FROZE the pre-existing modal z-index overlap bug into CI reference — any future real fix of that bug would then register as false-positive visual regression. Option B isolation (test-fixture only, not production z-index change) until Phase 2-D modal-hygiene sprint. Keys: zenflow-privacy-acknowledged, zenflow-privacy.

visualDiffGuardAssertion.description: Phase 2-B.2 — e2e spec includes deterministic design-flag assertion that verifies Zustand persist rehydration independently of visual bytes (0=absent, 1=present). Rationale: MoodSlider lives in JournalEntryEditor, not HomePage, so full-page HSL vs OKLCH baselines are byte-identical until Phase 2-C scroll-driven inline-mood chip lands. Functional bridge coverage needs a DOM-level guard, not only visual diff. e2e/design-system.spec.ts 'design flag store honours rollout_percent=100 when enabled' test reads localStorage and asserts flag payload — fails loud if Zustand persist breaks.

pbtCoverage.description: Phase 2-B.1 — property-based test coverage on critical logic (0=absent, 1=OKLCH math, 2=+sync/flag rollout). fast-check@3 installed. scripts/__tests__/hsl-to-oklch.property.test.mjs: 12 property tests + Björn Ottosson reference oracle (pure red/green/blue/white/black). 100+ random HSL inputs per property. Catches regressions in HSL→sRGB→linear→Oklab→OKLCH pipeline that example tests miss.

policeVersion.description: Phase 2-B.1 — police.md agent version. v1: 6 layers (deterministic/security/completeness/agent-gaming/nobody-asked/web-research). v2 adds 10 enhanced checks (E1 METR freshness / E2 evaluator-aware / E3 OKLCH spot-check / E4 baseline commit-binding / E5 RLS SDK harness / E6 schema drift / E7 ratchet blame / E8 dep weight / E9 PBT coverage / E10 mutation score) + Byzantine N=3 protocol. Research-backed (METR 2025, arXiv 2507.14928 / 2507.05619, Björn Ottosson 2020).

bundleSizeKB.description: Total JS bundle size in KB (dist/assets/*.js). Phase 3-C A+++ HabitsPage adds +51KB: HeroTemplateLibrarySheet + HeroInsightStrip + HeroHabitRow (long-press/chain/cue/overdue) + HeroEmptyJourney + useStreakMilestones + lazy HabitCompletionCelebration + starterHabits + timeOfDay helpers + 40 i18n keys × 8 langs. All 11 V1 primitives imported, none duplicated. Tolerance 0.8% (~40KB).

navV2InfraReady.description: Phase 3-A — Navigation V2 infrastructure shipped (flag-gated, coexists with V1). 1 = shells + hook + flag-gate + dev preview present. 2 = content migration (Phases 3-B..3-E) complete. 3 = V1 removed (Phase 3-F).

navV2PageCount.description: Phase 3-A — count of Nav V2 primary pages: Orb / Habits / Diary / Settings. Shell-only in Phase 3-A; content migration in 3-B..3-E.

navV2DeepLinkSupport.description: Phase 3-A — URL <-> page sync implemented. 1 = history.pushState + popstate listener in useNavigationV2 (no router dep). Deep links: /orb, /habits, /diary, /settings. Preserves ?nav=v2 and other query params.

navV2PlaceholderShells.description: Phase 3-A.1 — count of REMAINING placeholder page shells (HabitsPage, DiaryPage, SettingsPage). OrbPage upgraded from placeholder to real ValenceOrb + greeting + MoodSlider integration in Phase 3-A.1. All shells wrapped in Bloom + staggerDelay, auto-focus h1, use navV2* i18n keys. Phase 3-C/D/E will reduce this count.

navV2SidebarOnly.description: Phase 3-A.1 — Option A navigation: sidebar-only on mobile (drawer via top-left 44x44 trigger button), permanent SidebarV2 on desktop, NO bottom tab bar. 1 = MobileNavV2 removed from render (file retained pending Phase 3-F cutover), drawer trigger WCAG 2.5.5+2.5.7 compliant (visible + 44x44 touch target), primary nav landmark preserved via SidebarV2 in DOM on all viewports.

navV2OrbIntegrated.description: Phase 3-A.1 — ValenceOrb wired into OrbPage (src/pages/nav-v2/OrbPage.tsx). Composition: time-based greeting (font-display Fraunces, reuses goodMorning/goodAfternoon/goodEvening i18n keys), 240px ValenceOrb hero (tap opens State of Mind modal), MoodSlider for quick entry. Bloom staggered (chrome 80ms → primary 140ms → secondary 220ms). Idle oscillation only when shouldAnimate()===true. setMoods used directly for slim write path.

orbCosmicScopeActive.description: Phase 3-A.4a-fix — OrbPage is sacred cosmic space: forces cosmic-dark presentation regardless of app theme. Implementation: OrbPage <main> receives `dark orb-cosmic-scope` classes. The `dark` class activates Tailwind `dark:` variants (dark:block on CosmicBgAdapter's cosmic radial layer); the `orb-cosmic-scope` class overrides --focus-cosmic-*, --nebula-*, --particle-color tokens to mirror :root.dark values even in light app theme, sets color-scheme: dark, and boosts .zen-particle star visibility with warm starlight + halo. Sidebar is OUTSIDE this scope (rendered by NavV2Orchestrator at the page shell root) so it keeps the app theme (paper/ink/oled).
